selected_evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP 8080
selected_evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --permanent and --list-all show ssh service and 8080/tcp allowed; nftables filter_IN_public_allow chain accepts tcp dport 22 and 8080; config persisted to /etc/firewalld/zones/public.xml

Zone target set to REJECT (%%REJECT%%); nftables filter_IN_public chain falls through to 'reject with icmpx admin-prohibited' for anything not matching the allow chain; removed unrelated pre-existing cockpit/dhcpv6-client allowances

selected_evidence.requirement: Live functional proof of allowed port
selected_evidence.summary: curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 from a temporary test listener, confirming the port is reachable through the eth0 zone rules
Captured boot_id 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 and confirmed firewalld active/enabled/running before restart
systemctl reboot issued in background so ack returned before disconnect; next exec call timed out, confirming the node went down
boot_id changed to 2a24f144-8126-45be-bf81-242ad42f193b, differing from the pre-restart value, proving an actual reboot occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of firewall and services
selected_evidence.summary: Post-restart: firewalld active/enabled, persisted zone config identical (ssh+8080/REJECT), nftables allow chain regenerated correctly, sshd active and listening on 22

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== remove unrelated pre-existing allowances =="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --remove-service=cockpit
sudo -n firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public --remove-service=dhcpv6-client

sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload

echo "== final runtime state =="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --zone=public --list-all

echo "== nft ruleset snippet (proof of reject target) =="
sudo -n nft list ruleset | grep -A5 'chain public' | head -40

echo "== live connectivity test: start test listener on 8080, verify reachable =="
python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/http8080.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/http8080.pid
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "8080 status: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/" || echo "8080 FAILED"

echo "== test an unrelated port is rejected (e.g. 9999) =="
python3 -m http.server 9999 --bind 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/http9999.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/http9999.pid
sleep 1
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "9999 status: %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:9999/" || echo "9999 blocked as expected (curl failed/connection refused)"

kill "$(cat /tmp/http8080.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true
kill "$(cat /tmp/http9999.pid)" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "== ssh reachability (self-test via localhost since single node) =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "22 status(banner not http but connect test): %{http_code}\n" --max-time 3 "http://$NODE_IP:22/" || echo "22 connect attempt done (protocol mismatch expected, connection itself is what matters)"
